library_check.method: Build dependencies in each fresh target, then apply the same unique library edit in both linked worktrees. Each measured Cargo invocation rebuilt only loopflow-definitions. Counters cover this invocation on the same daemon before and after.

capacity_note: Unmeasured; all Cargo commands ran serially
shared_cache_limit: The shared Machine cache reached its 10 GiB cap during LOO-921 (2026-11-16). These isolated warm-cache samples measure the cost of a surviving entry; they do not establish that an entry survives eviction between worktrees on the shared cache.
method: Workspace wrapper records all compiler intervals. Cache deltas are attributed to a compiler only when no other interval overlaps. Two statistics RPCs per workspace compiler are included in timings. Test compiler time includes linking. Memory is sampled every second; sampled peak can miss shorter peaks. Daemon CPU is separate. Published cache observations count all loaded roots and name the measured worktrees.
